propositions: Rebar-janitor lacks a concern for oracle strength and contract coverage; two bugs escaped in 2026-08 because test assertions could fail without detecting contract violations
The antipattern vocabulary exists in code-review-tests.md but the janitor discovery phase never applies it to resting trees, only to diffs
A test-only finding receives prod_impact=none regardless of contract criticality, creating an impact floor that hides weak-oracle bugs
The eleven/twelve concern count drift between discovery.md and the verification schema is itself the failure mode concern #12 names—two artifact halves disagreeing with no oracle catching it
The portable fallback for rebar-janitor running on non-rebar repos lacks antipattern definitions, leaving concern #12 with no guidance outside rebar's codebase
